# BEGIN ProFluencer Awards (managed by GitHub Actions deploy — do not edit inside this block)
DirectoryIndex index.html
Options -Indexes

# index.html must never be served from a stale browser cache, otherwise
# visitors keep loading the previous build after a deploy. The JS/CSS in
# /assets have content-hashed names, so they can be cached for a year.
<IfModule mod_headers.c>
    <FilesMatch "^index\.html$">
        Header set Cache-Control "no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate"
        Header set Pragma "no-cache"
        Header set Expires "0"
    </FilesMatch>
    <FilesMatch "^index-[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.(js|css)$">
        Header set Cache-Control "public, max-age=31536000, immutable"
    </FilesMatch>
</IfModule>

<IfModule mod_rewrite.c>
    RewriteEngine On

    # Pass the Bearer token through to PHP (Sanctum auth).
    RewriteCond %{HTTP:Authorization} .
    RewriteRule .* - [E=HTTP_AUTHORIZATION:%{HTTP:Authorization}]

    # The Laravel app folder (backend/) is never web-reachable — second
    # layer on top of backend/.htaccess (Require all denied).
    RewriteRule ^backend(/|$) - [F,L]

    # /api and /api/... -> Laravel. Everything else is the static React
    # build.
    RewriteRule ^api(/.*)?$ laravel.php [L,QSA]

    # The React app uses hash routing (/#/admin). Redirect clean URLs that
    # people type or share (/admin, /login, /nominee/5) to their hash
    # route. Real files/folders and anything with a dot (assets, images,
    # .well-known files) are never redirected.
    RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-f
    RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-d
    RewriteRule ^([^.]+?)/?$ /#/$1 [R=302,NE,L]
</IfModule>
# END ProFluencer Awards
